beats.text: On April 2nd, Trump stood in the Rose Garden and declared tariffs on literally everyone.
He called it America's economic independence day. What followed was a giant poster board, like a game show host revealing the grand prize.

beats.caption: It's our Declaration of economic independence.
beats.label: via FOX 5 Washington DC

beats.caption: Make America Great Depression again.
beats.label: SNL Cold Open, via Saturday Night Live

beats.text: According to NPR, the White House divided each country's trade deficit by its exports, then cut that number in half. Economists call it made-up math.

beats.caption: So if you look at that, China: first row, China, 67%, that's tariffs.
beats.label: via FOX 5 Washington DC

beats.caption: ...with apologies to the speaker, I couldn't really focus.
beats.label: Brent Neiman, University of Chicago, via CNN

beats.text: Per Wikipedia, that poster became one of the most mocked props of his second term.
